description: Long move history per scenario factor, for the severity anchors (docs/design/scenario_set_and_ablation_design.md §3.3; src/scenariogen/long_history.py). Each factor reads its own long series; a factor too young for the dot-com / 2008 analogs gets a proxy's moves spliced in front of its own, volatility-matched over the shared dates (beta = sigma_own / sigma_proxy, at least min_overlap shared days). A factor with a match series (credit: BAA10Y matched to the ICE BofA IG OAS BAMLC0A0CM the credit factor is built from) uses its long series scaled to the match series volatility over the shared dates (replay.vol_matched), never raw. Units follow factor_keys.py: eq:/fx: simple returns; ir:/credit/eqvol percent-point change / 100. Inputs come from the market-data sources equity.yahoo_history and stress.fred_long.

credit:ORCL._why: No long issuer history (DTCC since 2025): anchored at IG-scale credit stress, the floor for a BBB issuer (scenario #8 lead).
